description: This file is a makefile fragment for configuring and building the Linux kernel in the OpenWrt build system, including kernel preparation, initramfs setup, and image compilation.

methods.name: Kernel/Prepare/Default
methods.description: Prepares the kernel source by extracting the Linux source archive or linking to an external kernel tree based on configuration.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs/PreConfigure
methods.description: Prepares the kernel configuration for initramfs, adjusting kernel config options based on whether initramfs is separate or integrated.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs
methods.description: Sets up the kernel configuration for initramfs, including compression options and root UID/GID.

methods.name: Kernel/SetNoInitramfs
methods.description: Removes initramfs configuration from the kernel config.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Default
methods.description: Configures the kernel using a default configuration command, copying kernel settings, and generating version info.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Initramfs
methods.description: Configures the kernel with initramfs settings.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileModules/Default
methods.description: Compiles kernel modules and saves the configuration state.

methods.name: Kernel/CopyImage
methods.description: Copies the compiled kernel image and related files to the target directory.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Default
methods.description: Builds the kernel image and copies it to the target directory.

methods.name: Kernel/PrepareConfigPerRootfs
methods.description: Prepares a kernel configuration directory per root filesystem.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Initramfs
methods.description: Builds an initramfs image if configured.
